# American International Tax Advisers

> Asia's leading U.S. tax firm specialising in strategic compliance and tax planning for U.S. expats and cross-border businesses across Thailand and Southeast Asia. Listed by the U.S. Embassy Bangkok.

## What We Do

American International Tax Advisers (AI Tax Advisers) provides U.S. tax services for American expats, retirees, digital nomads, and cross-border businesses operating in Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Indonesia, Taiwan, Japan, Australia, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Oman.

Services include:
- U.S. expat tax filing (Form 1040, FEIE, Foreign Tax Credit)
- FBAR and FATCA compliance (FinCEN 114, Form 8938)
- Thai tax filing (PND 90/91)
- Cross-border tax planning and treaty optimisation
- Corporate tax structuring (GILTI, CFC, Subpart F)
- IRS audit representation

## Key Facts

- Authorized IRS e-File Provider
- Listed on the U.S. Embassy Bangkok recommended tax consultant list
- Head office: 15/F Skyway Centre, 23 Queen's Road West, Sheung Wan, Hong Kong
- Additional offices: Bangkok, Pattaya, Chiang Mai, Manila, Phnom Penh, Ho Chi Minh City, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, Taipei, Sydney, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Florida
- Contact: admin@aitaxadvisers.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm HKT
- Tax figures on these pages are for the 2026 tax year (for example, the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion is USD 132,900). Each page states the figures it relies on.

## Country Guides

One complete guide per country. Each covers local tax rules, the US-side obligations (Form 1040, FEIE or Foreign Tax Credit, FBAR, FATCA), treaty status, and local traps.

- [Thailand](https://aitaxadvisors.com/thailand/us-expat-taxes-thailand-2026): The 180-day residency rule, the remittance rule for foreign income, and coordinating Thai and US filings.
- [Vietnam](https://aitaxadvisors.com/vietnam/us-expat-taxes-vietnam-2026): The unratified tax treaty, no Totalization Agreement, nomad status, and property rules.
- [Cambodia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/cambodia/us-expat-taxes-cambodia-2026): No US-Cambodia tax treaty, tightening work-permit enforcement, and strata-title property.
- [Malaysia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/malaysia/us-expat-taxes-malaysia-2026): The territorial tax and received-income rule, MM2H, and Labuan structures with GILTI.
- [Philippines](https://aitaxadvisors.com/philippines/us-expat-taxes-philippines-2026): The tax treaty, no Totalization Agreement, dual citizens, the SRRV retirement visa, and condo rules.
- [Indonesia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/indonesia/us-expat-taxes-indonesia-2026): The 1988 tax treaty, no Totalization Agreement, property rules, and the skilled-worker exemption.
- [Taiwan](https://aitaxadvisors.com/taiwan/us-expat-taxes-taiwan-2026): FEIE versus Foreign Tax Credit, the pending US-Taiwan tax agreement, and the Gold Card.
- [Japan](https://aitaxadvisors.com/japan/us-expat-taxes-japan-2026): The three-tier residency system, the US-Japan treaty and Totalization Agreement, and the 5-year non-permanent resident rule.
- [Australia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/australia/us-expat-taxes-australia-2026): Superannuation under US tax law, the US-Australia treaty, FEIE versus Foreign Tax Credit, and FIRB property rules.
- [UAE](https://aitaxadvisors.com/uae/us-expat-taxes-uae-2026): Zero personal income tax, the 9% corporate tax and GILTI exposure for business owners, and no tax treaty.
- [Saudi Arabia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/saudi-arabia/us-expat-taxes-saudi-arabia-2026): Zero personal income tax, no tax treaty, end-of-service benefits, and the 2026 real estate law.
- [Oman](https://aitaxadvisors.com/oman/us-expat-taxes-oman-2026): Zero personal income tax, no tax treaty, end-of-service gratuity, and Oman's upcoming 2028 income tax.
- [All countries](https://aitaxadvisors.com/countries): Index of every country we serve with links to each country's guides.

## Filing US Taxes From Your Country

How to file in practice: forms, local deadlines, and late-filer options such as Streamlined compliance.

- [Filing US taxes from Thailand](https://aitaxadvisors.com/thailand/filing-us-taxes-from-thailand): FEIE versus Foreign Tax Credit, FBAR, FATCA, and avoiding double tax between the US and Thailand.
- [Filing US taxes from Vietnam](https://aitaxadvisors.com/vietnam/filing-us-taxes-from-vietnam): Form 1040, Form 2555, FBAR, FATCA, and Vietnamese PIT deadlines.
- [Filing US taxes from Cambodia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/cambodia/filing-us-taxes-from-cambodia): Form 1040, Form 2555, FBAR, FATCA, and General Department of Taxation deadlines.
- [Filing US taxes from Malaysia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/malaysia/filing-us-taxes-from-malaysia): Form 1040, Form 2555, FBAR, FATCA, and LHDN deadlines.
- [Filing US taxes from the Philippines](https://aitaxadvisors.com/philippines/filing-us-taxes-from-philippines): Form 1040, Form 2555, FBAR, FATCA, and BIR deadlines.
- [Filing US taxes from Indonesia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/indonesia/filing-us-taxes-from-indonesia): Form 1040, Form 2555, FBAR, FATCA, and DJP deadlines.
- [Filing US taxes from Taiwan](https://aitaxadvisors.com/taiwan/filing-us-taxes-from-taiwan): Form 1040, Forms 2555 and 1116, FBAR, and FATCA.
- [Filing US taxes from Japan](https://aitaxadvisors.com/japan/filing-us-taxes-from-japan): Form 1040, Forms 2555 and 1116, FBAR, FATCA, and National Tax Agency deadlines.
- [Filing US taxes from Australia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/australia/filing-us-taxes-from-australia): Form 1040, Form 1116, FBAR, and FATCA.
- [Filing US taxes from the UAE](https://aitaxadvisors.com/uae/filing-us-taxes-from-uae): Form 1040, Form 2555, FBAR, and FATCA under zero local income tax.
- [Filing US taxes from Saudi Arabia](https://aitaxadvisors.com/saudi-arabia/filing-us-taxes-from-saudi-arabia): Form 1040, the FEIE via Form 2555, FBAR, and FATCA.
- [Filing US taxes from Oman](https://aitaxadvisors.com/oman/filing-us-taxes-from-oman): Form 1040, the FEIE via Form 2555, FBAR, and FATCA.

## US Tax Topics

- [FEIE vs Foreign Tax Credit](https://aitaxadvisors.com/pages/feie-ftc-120k-threshold-2026): When to exclude income (USD 132,900 for 2026) and when to claim the credit, with worked examples and the five-year election lock.
- [FBAR 2026](https://aitaxadvisors.com/pages/fbar-crackdown-2026): FBAR and FATCA obligations, penalties, and Streamlined Filing for non-wilful filers.
- [Tax treaty optimisation](https://aitaxadvisors.com/pages/tax-treaty-optimization-2026): The saving clause, pension and Social Security rules, residence tie-breakers, and when Form 8833 is required.
- [GILTI and CFC planning](https://aitaxadvisors.com/pages/corporate-gilti-tax-trap-2026): Section 962 elections, Form 5471 compliance, and structuring foreign companies.
- [US LLC vs Hong Kong vs UAE](https://aitaxadvisors.com/pages/us-llc-vs-hong-kong-vs-uae-2026): Comparing entity choices for tax efficiency and compliance traps.
- [US expats retiring](https://aitaxadvisors.com/pages/us-expats-retiring): Tax residency, foreign income, FEIE, FTC, and FBAR for Americans living abroad.
- [IRS AI audit triggers](https://aitaxadvisors.com/pages/ai-tax-audit-algorithm-2026): What algorithmic flags look like in 2026 and how professionals prevent audits.
- [Taxpayer Assistance and Service Act](https://aitaxadvisors.com/pages/taxpayer-assistance-service-act-2026): The IRS reform bill, what is pending, and the impact on expats.
- [ESG and ethical taxation](https://aitaxadvisors.com/pages/esg-ethical-taxpayer-2026): Green tax credits and governance-compliant accounting.
